name: multitenant
description: Multi-tenant SaaS basics. Applies when the change smells like tenant/account/role data.

rules.rule:
- Every read and write is bound to the caller's tenant and role; an id from the request is re-checked against that scope.
- Cache keys include the tenant and anything else that changes the answer.
- Rollout switches are runtime feature flags, not env vars or deploy-time settings.
- Background jobs carry the tenant explicitly; nothing runs 'for all tenants' by accident.
